decisions.what: Marked all interface properties readonly, with args typed as readonly string[] and env as Readonly<Record<string, string>>
decisions.why: The specification asked for readonly where appropriate; these types are immutable contracts shared across modules.

decisions.what: Used '../types.js' in the test import and './domain/types.js' in src/index.ts
decisions.why: tsconfig.json uses module/moduleResolution NodeNext with "type": "module", which requires explicit .js extensions on relative imports.

decisions.what: Verified readonly enforcement with @ts-expect-error inside non-invoked arrow functions
decisions.why: Readonly violations are compile-time only; wrapping them keeps the assertions type-checked without mutating the shared fixtures at runtime.

decisions.what: Defined local SucceededBuild/FailedBuild interfaces extending BuildResult in the test for the discriminated-union case
decisions.why: The union narrowing test was requested, but adding those variants to src/domain/types.ts would exceed the specified four types.

decisions.what: Kept jest configuration solely in jest.config.cjs rather than a package.json jest section
decisions.why: Spec 003 allowed either; spec 004 defines jest.config.cjs, so a single source of configuration avoids conflicts.
